purpose: Frozen-model diagnostic of uniform training exposure versus original cohort class frequencies
selection_rule: Report both raw and corrected scores for all six fixed final-epoch models; no best-model selection
limits: Use only saved weights and training-count metadata, not training arrays or refitting
All six original cross-entropies and confusion matrices must reproduce before any corrected inference
The uniform denominator adds one common constant versus logit plus log training prior; it makes uniform-prior identity exact
Do not estimate priors from validation labels or predictions; no smoothing, coefficient sweep, calibration or threshold search
Cohort frequencies are a diagnostic proxy, not measured operational traffic prevalence
Posterior correction assumes useful probability estimates and stable within-class distributions; neither is guaranteed
Report macro-F1, every class precision and recall, benign false alerts and attack error breakdowns; accuracy is secondary
Validation has already supported exploratory work; this is not independent assessment or deployment evidence
Keep cloud compute off and the final test sealed; no production decision change
